location.exact_quote:
・raise some suspicion among 〈people〉
用途: 説明できない事実が、人々の間に節の内容への疑いを生じさせる。
例: The unexplained gap in the records raised some suspicion among auditors that several invoices had been altered.

findings.rationale: The existing C-FRAMES-MW link points to F-MW-4. The Merriam-Webster entry directly gives “His story has raised some suspicion,” and separately gives an arouse-someone’s-suspicions-that example; it does not attest the claimed complete frame raise some suspicion among 〈people〉 that 〈clause〉. Those examples do not establish the added among + noun phrase + that-clause construction or the article example’s naturalness as that complete frame.
findings.suggested_direction: Limit this item to the source-attested raise some suspicion pattern, or add direct evidence for the complete among + noun phrase + that-clause frame and its example.
